args.title: Ironbark Tooling: Cold-Chain Logistics 2026 Summary
args.body:
- Newsletter headline: "Cold-chain logistics in 2026" highlights the shift toward live sensor data sharing among carriers as the key 2026 trend.
- Main article: Temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data in real time; most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage.
- Companion piece: Pilot programs using this shared-data approach cut insurance/logistics claims by roughly 25%, reinforcing the main article's findings.
